title: Listen for Problems
goal: Hear someone's problem and imagine the program that helps.
mascot_lines: Builders LISTEN. They hear a problem and think:
Match each problem to the kind of program that helps!

tier2.rephrase: Each card tells you a problem. Match it to the helper program.

tier3.nudge: Lost photos need a finder. Forgotten lists need a list. Rain needs a weather check.

payload.prompt: Match each problem to the kind of program that helps:

pairs.left: Mom keeps forgetting the grocery list
Dad has 100 photos and can't find one
My sister doesn't know if it's raining
I want to practice times tables
